name: suunto_get_authorization_url
description: Build the Suunto OAuth browser authorization URL.

name: suunto_exchange_authorization_code
description: Exchange a Suunto OAuth authorization code for tokens and store them locally.

name: suunto_import_token_set
description: Store an existing Suunto access token and optional refresh token without exposing token values.

name: suunto_import_token_file
description: Import a token JSON response file created by a trusted OAuth test flow.

name: suunto_refresh_token
description: Refresh one stored Suunto account, or all accounts that have refresh tokens.

name: suunto_list_accounts
description: List stored Suunto accounts without secrets.

name: suunto_auth_status
description: Report whether stored account tokens are usable.

name: suunto_deauthorize
description: Call Suunto OAuth deauthorize for an account and optionally remove local tokens.

name: suunto_list_workouts
description: List workouts for an authorized Suunto account using the current /v3/workouts API.

name: suunto_get_workout
description: Fetch one Suunto workout JSON document.

name: suunto_get_workout_fit
description: Download a workout FIT file as metadata, base64, file, or both.

name: suunto_parse_workout_fit
description: Download a workout FIT file and parse sessions, laps, events, and optional records.

name: suunto_get_complete_workout
description: Fetch workout JSON plus optional FIT metadata and parsed FIT summary.

name: suunto_add_workout_description_info
description: Add information to a workout description. Requires SUUNTO_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=true.

name: suunto_list_workouts_deprecated_v2
description: List workouts using Suunto's deprecated /v2/workouts API. Prefer suunto_list_workouts.

name: suunto_get_workout_deprecated_v2
description: Fetch one workout using Suunto's deprecated /v2/workouts API. Prefer suunto_get_workout.

name: suunto_get_workout_fit_deprecated_v2
description: Download a FIT file using Suunto's deprecated /v2/workouts API. Prefer suunto_get_workout_fit.

name: suunto_get_activity_samples
description: Fetch 24/7 activity samples for a Suunto account.

name: suunto_get_sleep_data
description: Fetch 24/7 sleep samples where available for the account/API subscription.

name: suunto_get_recovery_data
description: Fetch 24/7 recovery samples where available for the account/API subscription.

name: suunto_get_daily_activity_statistics
description: Fetch daily activity statistics for a date range.

name: suunto_estimate_247_summary_calls
description: Estimate Suunto API calls for a 24/7 summary without fetching data.

name: suunto_get_247_summary
description: Fetch activity, sleep, recovery, and daily statistics using 28-day chunks.

name: suunto_get_legacy_daily_activity
description: Fetch the legacy daily activity API surface when enabled for the subscription.

name: suunto_get_legacy_daily_activity_statistics
description: Fetch legacy daily activity statistics when enabled for the subscription.

name: suunto_list_routes
description: List routes for an authorized Suunto account.

name: suunto_get_route
description: Fetch one route metadata document by route id.

name: suunto_export_route_gpx
description: Export a Suunto route as GPX.

name: suunto_parse_route_gpx
description: Export a Suunto route as GPX and parse tracks, routes, and waypoints.

name: suunto_import_route_gpx
description: Import a local GPX route into Suunto App. Requires SUUNTO_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=true.

name: suunto_init_workout_upload
description: Initialize a Suunto FIT workout upload. Requires SUUNTO_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=true.

name: suunto_upload_workout_fit_to_signed_url
description: Upload a FIT file to the signed object-storage URL returned by suunto_init_workout_upload.

name: suunto_get_upload_status
description: Fetch Suunto workout upload status.

name: suunto_wait_for_upload_status
description: Poll Suunto workout upload status until a terminal state or attempt limit.

name: suunto_upload_workout_fit
description: Initialize and upload a FIT file to Suunto App. Requires SUUNTO_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=true.

name: suunto_list_guides
description: List SuuntoPlus Guides for an account.

name: suunto_get_guide
description: Fetch a SuuntoPlus Guide ZIP/file by id.

name: suunto_validate_guide_json
description: Validate a SuuntoPlus guide JSON object or guide.json file before upload.

name: suunto_create_guide_zip
description: Create a local SuuntoPlus guide ZIP from guide.json and icon.png.

name: suunto_create_guide
description: Upload a SuuntoPlus guide ZIP. Requires SUUNTO_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=true.

name: suunto_update_guide
description: Replace a SuuntoPlus guide ZIP. Requires SUUNTO_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=true.

name: suunto_delete_guide
description: Delete a SuuntoPlus Guide. Requires SUUNTO_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=true.

name: suunto_parse_fit_file
description: Parse a local FIT file without storing it.

name: suunto_parse_gpx_file
description: Parse a local GPX file without storing it.

name: suunto_import_fit_file
description: Register a local FIT file and cache a parsed summary in the local import index.

name: suunto_import_gpx_file
description: Register a local GPX route/track file and cache a parsed summary.

name: suunto_import_activity_json
description: Register a local normalized activity JSON file.

name: suunto_parse_activity_csv
description: Parse a local CSV/TSV activity file without storing it.

name: suunto_import_activity_csv
description: Register a local CSV/TSV activity file and cache a bounded preview summary.

name: suunto_parse_health_export
description: Parse a local Apple Health export.xml file without storing it.

name: suunto_import_health_export
description: Register a local Apple Health export.xml file and cache a bounded summary.

name: suunto_list_imported_files
description: List locally imported files.

name: suunto_get_imported_activity
description: Inspect and parse an imported file.

name: suunto_verify_webhook_signature
description: Verify a Suunto webhook HMAC SHA-256 signature.

name: suunto_store_webhook_event
description: Store a webhook notification payload in the configured local webhook store.

name: suunto_list_webhook_events
description: List locally stored webhook events.

name: suunto_get_webhook_event
description: Get one locally stored webhook event by id.

name: suunto_delete_webhook_event
description: Delete one locally stored webhook event by id.

name: suunto_suggest_webhook_followups
description: Suggest MCP fetch tools to call after receiving a Suunto webhook event.

name: suunto_api_quota_status
description: Inspect local Suunto API quota usage.
